title: Rank of finite flat pushforward on a constant-rank open
statement: Let f : X → Y be a finite, flat and locally finitely presented morphism of schemes. Let U be an open of Y and n a natural number. If the morphism rank f.finrank is n at every point of U, then the restriction to U of f_* O_X is finite locally free of rank n.

proof.text: On affine opens contained in U, the sections of the pushforward are a finite flat finitely presented algebra, so the existing finite-flat pushforward argument gives finite local freeness.

The affine definition and base-change invariance of morphism rank identify local module rank with f.finrank. The hypothesis gives constant rank n; localizing a finite projective module gives rank-n trivializations, which cover U and define rank-n local generators data on its over site.
